set.body: Create a small deterministic surface test corpus derived from neurosurf concepts: tetrahedron, two-triangle fragmented parcel mesh, skewed centroid fixture, small spherical fixture, and minimal FreeSurfer/GIFTI resources where licensing/size permit. Acceptance: fixtures are documented, checked into the right test resources, used by core/topology/geodesic/parcel/IO tests, and avoid large bundled neuroimaging assets unless explicitly approved. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface/fixtures, modules/surface/jvm/src/test/resources, tools/r-parity.
set.title: Surface parity fixtures and test corpus
